# GTS Segment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](gmeow-GTSSegment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GTSSegment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

One complete header-plus-frames log inside a GTS document — the unit of independent integrity (spec §3.1): a segment has its own genesis hash, its own id/prev chain, its own profile, its own transform catalog, and its own signers. Segments compose by concatenation and never vouch for one another; a third-party segment keeps its third-party attestation. Itself a [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md): a segment is a complete, independently shippable artifact.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

Use [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](gmeow-GTSSegment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
